title: User Authentication - Successful Login
description: Verify that users with valid credentials for admin, manager, and user roles can successfully login and receive appropriate session management with active timeout control.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter valid username/email and password for each role: admin, manager, user
Click the login button
Verify that login is successful and user is redirected to the correct role-specific dashboard
Verify session is created and timeout management is active

title: User Authentication - Failed Login with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that login attempts with incorrect username/email or password fail and appropriate error messages are displayed without creating sessions.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input invalid username/email and/or password
Click the login button
Verify that login is denied and appropriate error message is shown
Verify no session is created

title: Password Reset Workflow
description: Verify that users can successfully initiate and complete a password reset process and login with the new password.

steps.description: Navigate to the password reset page
Enter valid registered email and submit password reset request
Verify that email with password reset instructions is sent
Follow password reset link and set a new password
Verify password reset is successful
Attempt login with new password
Verify login succeeds

title: Session Timeout Enforcement
description: Verify that the system respects configured session timeout settings and logs out users automatically after inactivity.

steps.description: Login as any user role
Remain inactive for the configured session timeout period
Verify user is logged out and redirected to login page

title: User Management - Create and Invite Users
description: Verify that admins and managers can create and invite new users with appropriate role assignments and that invited users receive notifications.

steps.description: Login as admin
Navigate to User Management interface
Create new user by filling required details and selecting role
Send invitation to new user email
Verify user is created with correct role and invitation email is sent
Repeat invitation process as a manager and verify permissions

title: User Management - Delete User with Permission Enforcement
description: Verify that only authorized roles (admin and managers) can delete users and actions are logged properly; deletion fails for unauthorized roles.

steps.description: Login as manager
Attempt to delete a subordinate user
Verify user is deleted successfully and deletion logs are created
Login as regular user
Attempt to delete any user
Verify delete action is denied with permission error

title: Report Upload - Successful Upload and Validation
description: Verify that users can upload Excel reports successfully and system validates file format and contents for correctness.

steps.description: Login as regular user
Navigate to Report Upload page
Upload a valid Excel report file
Verify upload succeeds and report is listed with pending approval status

title: Report Upload - Reject Invalid Excel Format
description: Verify system rejects report uploads with unsupported file types or corrupted Excel files with appropriate error messages.

steps.description: Login as user
Attempt to upload a non-Excel or corrupted file
Verify upload is rejected with appropriate validation error message

title: Report Management - Approve and Reject Reports
description: Verify that admins and managers can review, approve, or reject uploaded reports and changes in status are reflected properly.

steps.description: Login as admin
Navigate to Reports Management page
View a pending report detail
Approve the report
Verify report status changes to approved
Reject another pending report with reason
Verify report status changes to rejected and reason is logged

title: Payment Management - Upload Payment Proofs
description: Verify users can upload payment proofs successfully and submissions are listed for admin/manager review.

steps.description: Login as user
Navigate to Payment Upload page
Upload a valid payment proof document
Verify upload succeeds and payment proof is listed as pending

title: Payment Review - Approval and Rejection by Admin and Manager
description: Verify admins and managers can view payment proofs and approve or reject them with correct status updates.

steps.description: Login as manager
Navigate to Payments Management page
Review a pending payment proof
Approve the payment
Verify payment status changes to approved
Reject another payment with explanation
Verify status changes to rejected and rejection reason is recorded

title: Attendance Submission with Geolocation and Photo Verification
description: Verify users can submit attendance entries with valid geolocation coordinates and photo evidence, and that submissions are properly stored.

steps.description: Login as user
Navigate to Attendance Submission page
Submit attendance with valid geolocation and captured photo
Verify submission is recorded successfully and listed as pending review

title: Attendance Submission - Validation of Geolocation and Photo
description: Verify that submissions with missing or invalid geolocation or photo evidence are rejected with appropriate validation errors.

steps.description: Attempt attendance submission without geolocation data
Verify submission is rejected with validation error
Attempt attendance submission without photo
Verify submission is rejected with validation error

title: Attendance Review by Admin and Manager
description: Verify that managers and admins can view, validate and approve or reject attendance submissions appropriately.

steps.description: Login as admin
Navigate to Attendance Management page
Review an attendance submission
Approve the attendance
Verify status changes to approved
Reject another attendance submission with reason
Verify status changes to rejected with reason captured

title: Dashboard Analytics - Role-Based Data Display
description: Verify that dashboards show correct analytics, statistics, and recent activities tailored to the logged-in user's role (admin, manager, user).

steps.description: Login as admin
Navigate to Admin Dashboard
Verify analytics statistics and recent activities are displayed correctly for admin role
Repeat login and dashboard check as manager
Verify manager-specific analytics and recent activities
Repeat login and dashboard check as user
Verify user-specific dashboard data

title: Real-time Notifications Delivery and Accuracy
description: Verify that users receive real-time notifications for system events including approvals, rejections, and key updates promptly and accurately.

steps.description: Trigger events such as report approval, payment rejection, attendance validation changes
Verify respective users receive instantaneous notifications with correct event details

title: Settings Management - Change and Persist Session Timeout
description: Verify that administrators can change session timeout settings and that the new settings persist and affect session management behavior.

steps.description: Login as system administrator
Navigate to Settings page
Change session timeout duration
Save settings
Verify settings change persists after page refresh or logout/login
Login as any user and verify that session expires according to new timeout
Verify session timeout behavior aligns with updated setting

title: Settings Management - Geofencing Configuration and Enforcement
description: Verify that geofencing parameters can be configured and that attendance submissions outside the configured geofence are rejected appropriately.

steps.description: Login as system administrator
Set geofencing parameters on Settings page
Save settings
Attempt attendance submission with geolocation outside defined geofence
Verify submission is rejected with geofencing policy violation message
Attempt attendance submission with geolocation within geofence
Verify submission is accepted

title: User Role Permissions Enforcement
description: Verify that actions across the portal are permitted or denied correctly based on the logged-in user's role, preventing unauthorized access or operations.

steps.description: Login as regular user
Attempt to access admin-only pages and perform admin-level actions
Verify access is denied and no unauthorized changes can be made
Login as manager
Attempt to perform admin-only operations
Verify such operations are blocked

title: System Stability Under Concurrent Usage
description: Verify the Enterprise Admin Portal handles concurrent uploads, edits, and reviews by multiple users without data corruption or significant performance degradation.

steps.description: Simulate multiple users concurrently uploading reports and payment proofs
Simultaneously perform review and approval actions by managers and admins
Verify no data loss, corruption, or UI errors occur and system performance remains acceptable
